svg.text: Chunk c0 of rows 0–7: one per bank group.
Rows stay intact; only the 16-byte chunks move.
cN = the N-th 16-byte chunk (8 bf16 values) of a row, as the program sees it. Blue: the chunk that one MMA operand load reads from each row.
